card.title: 75mm PACK HOWITZER
card.flavorText: The 75mm Pack Howitzer M1 was an American made artillery piece used by the United States and their Allies. It was designed for moving over difficult terrain and was primarily used by airborne units of the United States Army and the US Marine Corps.
